messages:
Maya Bennett: Folks — quick sync re: last night's incident. Need a PIR host and a couple of attendees. Proposed slot: Tue 2026-03-23 10:00 PT (60m). Who can host?
IncidentBot: Incident #482 — infer-service-high-5xx — start: 2026-03-19T23:12:00Z end: 2026-03-19T23:47:00Z. Impact: increased 5xx for Dedicated customers in us-west, ~2.3% failed requests during window. Auto-mitigation: scaled pool + rollback. Actions created: #INV-482-01 (rollback), #INV-482-02 (capacity test).
Sam Cho: I can host. Prefer Tue 10am PT works for me. :raised_hands:
Priya Raman: I can attend and take action ownership for capacity test. OK for Tue.
Jordan Li: I have a conflict at 10:00 PT — can we shift to 11:00 PT? If not, I can shadow asynchronously.
Maya Bennett: Can we do 10:30 PT instead? Middle ground?
Kyle Ortega: 10:30 PT works for me. Also can prep a short runbook snippet and share pre-read.
Maya Bennett: Thanks — Sam, do you want to host or should I nominate? If you host, I'll take notes.
Sam Cho: Happy to host. Will grab the PIR template and send invite.
Maya Bennett: Cool. Attendees: @Priya Raman (capacity test owner), @Kyle Ortega (runbook + logs), @Jordan Li (shadow/async). If anyone else should be there, add now.
Jordan Li: I'll watch the recording if timing still awkward. Assign any follow-ups to me if there's infra code work.
IncidentBot: Calendar invite created: PIR - Incident #482 (Sam Cho host) — 2026-03-23 10:30 PT. Link: https://redwood.zoom/meet/INV482
Kyle Ortega: Pre-read: https://redwood.internal/pir/INV-482 (short logs + timeline). I'll drop a 5-slide summary by EOD Mon.
Priya Raman: Will prepare the capacity test results and recommended thresholds. Need any specific perf graphs?
Maya Bennett: Perf graphs for p95 latency + retry rate would be great. Also capture which model variants were routed as fallback.
Sam Cho: Noted. I'll add an agenda to the invite: 1) timeline, 2) customer impact, 3) mitigation steps, 4) action assignment. Target: finish RCA & actions within 1 week.
Priya Raman: :thumbsup: I'll own INV-482-02 and update the tracker.
Maya Bennett: Thanks. Anyone wants to co-host or swap? If not, we'll lock this in tomorrow morning.
Jordan Li: :calendar: I can join 10:30-11:00 PT if it helps, then leave for another meeting.
Sam Cho: Great — I'll publish notes and action items after the PIR. Tagging incident-sig for visibility. @incident-sig
Maya Bennett: :ok_hand:
